facts.value: In 2006 Gabriel Orozco installed an 11.7 metre grey whale skeleton in the library. It was found beached on Isla Arena in Baja California.
facts.quote: installed an 11.7 metre grey whale skeleton in Mexico City
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.tate.org.uk/tate-etc/issue-21-spring-2011/where-can-i-get-whale-skeleton' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'installed an 11.7 metre grey whale skeleton in Mexico City'

facts.value: The reassembled whale skeleton consists of 169 bones, with only one of the tympanums missing.
The botanical garden covers 70 per cent of the site and holds almost 60,000 plants of 168 species, according to El Universal.
facts.quote: 168 especies de árboles, arbustos y hierbas

facts.value: The library closed in March 2007 with more than 3,000 unfinished tasks. Critics said the Fox government had rushed construction to open before a hotly contested election.
facts.quote: list of more than 3,000 unfinished tasks
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.architecturalrecord.com/articles/3689-kalach-s-mexico-city-library-shuttered' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'list of more than 3,000 unfinished tasks'
